hints.title: Accumulate Consecutive Ones
hints.text: For each cell (r, c), compute consecutive 1s ending at that cell: height = (matrix[r][c] == 1 ? height[r-1][c] + 1 : 0).

hints.title: Sort Row Heights
hints.text: For any row, reordering columns is equivalent to sorting the column heights in descending order.

hints.title: Maximize Area Per Row
hints.text: After sorting heights descending, a rectangle of height h[i] can have width i + 1, giving area h[i] * (i + 1).

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all column permutations takes O(n! * m) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Column height accumulation plus sorting each row achieves polynomial O(m * n log n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate transforms arbitrary column reordering into independent row height sorting.
